result.name: bright green tubular chassis / roll-cage frame
visual_evidence: Image 1 shows a neon-green plastic tubular frame forming the open roll-cage/body of the RC car, with four black wheels mounted to its axles
Image 2 crop clearly shows the same green frame rails wrapping around the breadboard, blue relay module, and wiring
The green structure is structural tubing, not wire insulation, and contrasts sharply with black tires, silver duct tape, and red/yellow/orange leads
other_possibilities: Could be confused with green wiring, but no green conductors are visible; the green is rigid frame material
Might be described as a body shell, but it is an open frame chassis rather than an enclosed body
